**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Alice](../persons.html#1025),
I was thinking of sending ‘The Mice at Play’ to [Maggie](../persons.html#83), but somehow I felt that the note must be to one who could remember the old days, when the three bright faces[^2] it brings to mind were with us.

If you had been people who shrank from such recollections instead of cherishing them, I would of course never have disinterred this old affair, but I know you will like the recurrence to those merry old days and bright remembrances.

[^1]: This is printed by the author of Dulce Domum as part of a group of fragments with dates ranging from May to October 1864.

[^2]: Two of the faces must be those of Alice’s second brother, [Arthur Moberly](../persons.html#1011) (1840?-1858), and second sister, [Mary Louisa (Moberly) Ridding](../persons.html#1020) (1838-1859).

The third person was perhaps [WCY](../persons.html#1631).
